spiritual_reading:
The inflowing power acted upon what was lowest and inert, and those who were immersed in the final, obscure degree of life were stirred into activity within the first completed state of their denial.

But after a long interval, because there was no reception of living good and truth, what lay hidden in that denial forced itself outward and broke forth into manifestation. From the intention of spiritual death there erupted a sufficient series of fundamental corruptions: obscured understanding, self‑exalting love, unstable persuasion, falsified truth, and active denial of good. These arose again with renewed force, and they were brought into fixed forms of life; and within those forms spiritual death was made to dwell as a settled principle.

From this there proceeded the fourth completed state: works wholly perverted, produced through a sufficient set of organized distorted perceptions, each operating within its own general domain of falsity.

Then the fifth completed state extended itself into all the derivative lives that existed throughout those general domains—lives that had been fashioned and propagated from the perverted works that sprang from spiritual death. These were the totality of merely bodily life, and the full array of falsities in which spiritual death had been established. This extension divided itself into a complete duality, a sufficient set in the active form and a sufficient set in the receptive form, so that denial might operate through both will and understanding.

And as the wholly false ultimate degree, by its ruling affection and its dominant persuasion, sustained those fundamental corruptions, so also that complete duality—active and receptive—fed the burning of self‑love and the craving of merely bodily life. By joining those two within themselves and binding them together, they were fixed in opposition to the first good that directly confronted evil. In this consists the final state of that falsity: it was separated from heaven’s order and held in that separation without end.

Together with this there arose a hidden structure of a full organized set of falsities that came to be within denial, all set in opposition to the first good that confronts evil. This fullness took form as a complete series of misleading influences—total persuasions of error—generated from a complete framework of outward knowledges turned into a system that governs and misleads.

fills.fill: The third time, when the thought came forth from the land of darkness,
fills.notes: The sequence of “parts” and “times” in ¶3–¶6 requires ¶2 to introduce the third completed state. The substrate speaks in impersonal cosmogonic cycles: an emanated motion from Darkness that stirs what is lowest.

fills.fill: it moved it and gathered it together;
fills.notes: The spiritual sense says an inflowing power acted on what was lowest and inert; in the natural register this is Darkness’ thought moving and collecting its lower mass into an active state.
Matches “final, obscure degree” in the spiritual translation: the lowest region of the dark earth is regularly called its depth.
The phrase is the fixed formula “the earth of darkness.”
Spiritual context: “no reception of living good and truth,” i.e., no settling into order; the oldest layer casts this as the absence of repose, so the dark substance cannot remain contained.
Correspondentially the hidden denial forces itself outward; the natural expression is eruption from within.

fills.fill: from the first root of death,
fills.notes: The five elements are said to gush from the root or source of Death in the Iranian-cosmological register, fitting the spiritual ‘intention of spiritual death’.
Completes the gushing imagery: eruption upward into manifestation.
Standard narrative hinge between eruption and the next ordering step (“second time”).
Grammar-link before “the second time.”

fills.fill: into bodies and forms of their own;
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: “brought into fixed forms of life.” In the oldest natural register this is sculpting into bodies and forms where Death can ‘dwell’.
Connects “evil fruits” to their generation from the prior forming; keeps the impersonal cosmogonic tone.
The sentence demands completion of the dual division: five male and five female parts.
Spiritual sense: ruling affection and dominant persuasion; in the substrate these are typically ‘spirit’ and ‘thought’ as the two interior principals of the dark land.
The nourishing is performed by the inner principals upon the elements; this supplies the object for “they nourished…”.
Parallels the clause just before: as spirit and thought nourished the five elements, so the ten parts nourish lust and fire of flesh.
Required verb for “the fire and lust of the flesh … them”; the spiritual sense uses “fed”.
Spiritual translation: “In this consists the final state of that falsity.” The natural register calls it “the end of the darkness,” i.e., its last completed state.
Matches the repeated pattern “established against the First Man” and the spiritual “all set in opposition”.
Balances the structure: “The twelve parts: the twelve spirits of error…”.

fills.fill: and from the twelve powers that are in them.
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: a complete framework of outward knowledges turned into a governing system. In the natural astrological register, the ‘signs’ bear ‘powers’ that generate the spirits of error.

assessment: Most gaps are recoverable because the chapter is structured as a numbered sequence of completed ‘times’ and ‘parts’ (third through fifth; then tenfold duality; then twelvefold system). The correspondential constraints strongly fix the needed items: eruption from within, five elements of Death, ten male and female parts, nourishment by the dark land’s interior principles, final state and condemnation, and a twelvefold error-system generated from the zodiacal framework. A few phrases (especially ¶2–¶3 transitions and the exact source-term for the five elements) remain moderately constrained rather than exact-word certain.
